race.comment: RED CODE (1) has been in the market at his last couple of starts but hasn't made an impression, last start finishing ninth over 1400m at Gold Coast. Rates highly in this line up and can improve sharply. CRYPTOLOGY (2) ran a nice race last time out, finishing third and beaten only 0.8 lengths over 1600m at Rockhampton. Finds the right race this time and can get the job done. BUZ FUZ (7) did little and finished 5.5 lengths from the winner in fifth over 800m at Corfield last start, a less impressive effort than his fourth at Hughenden the run before. Needs to be at his best to beat this field but he has the ability to mix it with them. AZCONPETE (11) doesn't win out of turn but is usually thereabouts and may earn some minor money.
